reason: A zero-configuration browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds restrained semantic interface motion while preserving host layout control and reduced-motion preferences.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的菜单、面板、对话框、标签页和工作区状态提供克制且遵循减少动态效果设置的界面动效。
summaries.en: Adds restrained, semantic animations to DeepSeek Harness menus, panels, dialogs, tabs, and workspace states while respecting reduced-motion preferences.

capabilities: Adds restrained entry, exit, and state-transition animations to semantic Harness interface elements
Respects prefers-reduced-motion and supports disabling motion for a subtree
Uses browser-side client integration without described external services or data processing
